title: 3 Kinds of People Allah Loves
_accuracy: Every point is an explicit Qur'anic statement of Allah's love (inna Allāha yuḥibb…). No hadith grading needed — these are direct āyāt. Arabic on the ayah beat is pulled live from Quran.com (KFGQPC Uthmani), never hand-typed. Verify final render before publishing.
_visuals: B-roll queries are nature / sky / architecture only — no people, no faces, no human depictions.

beats.say: Allah named the exact people He loves. It's right here in the Qur'an. Here are three.
One. The ones who keep coming back. Every time they fall, they turn straight back to Him.
Two. The ones who stay fair. Even when it costs them. Even against their own side.
Three. The ones who do good. Quietly. Expecting nothing back.
And these aren't just words. Allah described them Himself.
So which one will you become? Save this, and follow for more.

sources: Qur'an 2:222 — 'Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.'
Qur'an 60:8 (also 49:9) — 'Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.'
Qur'an 2:195 (also 3:134) — 'And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.'
Qur'an 3:134 — 'Who spend during ease and hardship, and restrain anger, and pardon the people — and Allah loves the doers of good.'
